title: TRIAD partners meet for the kick-off
summary: The TRIAD consortium came together in September 2026 for its kick-off meeting, organised by the coordinator, Rheinland-Pfälzische Technische Universität Kaiserslautern-Landau (RPTU).
body:
The TRIAD consortium came together for its kick-off meeting in September 2026. The meeting was organised by the coordinator, Rheinland-Pfälzische Technische Universität Kaiserslautern-Landau (RPTU).

All partners introduced their organisations and project teams. In a session called "Setting the scene", the partners then worked through the first two research work packages: WP1, which reviews pedagogical models, competences and AI tools, and WP3, which gathers neuroscientific evidence on AI-enhanced learning.

The project started on 1 September 2026 and runs for 36 months, until 31 August 2029. Who is taking part is on the Consortium page.
